CREATE PROC [DW].[SP_CI_Demographics_Corporate_CR_20230816] AS
BEGIN


IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'CI_Demographics_Corporate_En') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.CI_Demographics_Corporate_En;
END;

WITH DimAccount AS (
    SELECT * FROM DW.DimAccount 
    WHERE SourceSystemCode IN ('DEP', 'LNS', 'CCD', 'TRU', 'TRY')
)
,HIERARCCHY AS (
    SELECT 1 AS SEQ, 'CRM' SOURCE UNION ALL
    SELECT 2 AS SEQ, 'CCD' SOURCE UNION ALL
    SELECT 3 AS SEQ, 'SEC' SOURCE
)
,DimCustomer AS (
    SELECT *
    ,CONCAT('Entity_CIF_', SourceSystemCode, '_', CustomerID)  AS EntityCIF
    ,NULL AS RN
    FROM DW.dimcustomer_enhancement
    WHERE CurrentIndicator = '1' AND  CustomerType = 'Corporate' AND GlobalCIF IS NULL

    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT DC.* , REPLACE(GlobalCIF,'Global_CIF_','Entity_CIF_') AS EntityCIF, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY REPLACE(GlobalCIF,'Global_CIF_','Entity_CIF_') ORDER BY SEQ) RN 
    FROM DW.dimcustomer_enhancement DC
    LEFT JOIN HIERARCCHY B ON DC.sourcesystemcode = B.SOURCE
    WHERE CurrentIndicator = '1' AND  CustomerType = 'Corporate' AND GlobalCIF IS NOT NULL 
    ) A WHERE RN = 1
)
,DimCustomerRisk AS(
    SELECT * FROM(
    SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerSK ORDER BY CustomerSK) RN, CustomerSK,RiskRatingTypeSK,RiskRatingSK  FROM DW.DimCustomerRiskRating
    )A WHERE RN = 1
     
)
,CI_Deposits_Corporate AS (
    SELECT FCBSCIF 
    ,SUM(MonthToDateAverageDailyBalance_Full) AS MonthToDateAverageDailyBalance_Full          
    ,SUM(MonthToDateAverageDailyBalance_Shared) AS MonthToDateAverageDailyBalance_Shared
    ,SUM(YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Full) AS YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Full
    ,SUM(YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Shared) AS YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Shared
    ,SUM(OutstandingBalance_Full) AS OutstandingBalance_Full 
    ,SUM(OutstandingBalance_Shared) AS OutstandingBalance_Shared 
    FROM DW.CI_Deposit_Corporate_En CDC
    JOIN DW.DimAccount DA ON DA.AccountId = CDC.AccountId
    WHERE DA.AccountStatus not in ('Closed')
    GROUP BY FCBSCIF
)
,CI_Cards_Corporate AS (
    SELECT FCBSCIF 
    ,SUM(RelationshipExposure) AS RelationshipExposure          
    ,SUM(StatementBalance) AS StatementBalance
    ,SUM(CreditLimit) AS CreditLimit
    FROM DW.CI_Cards_Corporate_En CCC
    JOIN DW.DimAccount DA ON DA.AccountId = CCC.AccountId
    WHERE DA.AccountStatus not in ('8')
    GROUP BY FCBSCIF
)
,CI_Loans_Corporate AS (  
    SELECT FCBSCIF   
    ,SUM(RelationshipExposure_Full) AS RelationshipExposure_Full  
    ,SUM(RelationshipExposure_Shared) AS RelationshipExposure_Shared  
    ,SUM(DueForTheMonth_Full) AS DueForTheMonth_Full  
    ,SUM(DueForTheMonth_Shared) AS DueForTheMonth_Shared  
    ,SUM(CreditLimit_Full) AS CreditLimit_Full  
    ,SUM(CreditLimit_Shared) AS CreditLimit_Shared  
    FROM DW.CI_Loans_Corporate_En CLC
    JOIN DW.DimAccount DA ON DA.AccountId = CLC.AccountId
    WHERE DA.AccountStatus not in ('Closed') 
    GROUP BY FCBSCIF
)
,CI_Securities_Corporate AS ( 
    SELECT FCBSCIF 
    ,SUM(PortfolioSize_Full) AS PortfolioSize_Full  
    ,SUM(PortfolioSize_Shared) AS PortfolioSize_Shared  
    FROM DW.CI_Securities_Corporate_En  
    GROUP BY FCBSCIF  
)
,CI_Trust_Corporate AS ( 
    SELECT FCBSCIF 
    ,SUM(AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Full) AS AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Full  
    ,SUM(AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Shared) AS AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Shared  
    FROM DW.CI_Trust_Corporate_En  
    GROUP BY FCBSCIF  
)
,CI_Treasury_Corporate AS ( 
    SELECT FCBSCIF 
    ,SUM(OutstandingInvestmentFull) AS OutstandingInvestment_Full  
    ,SUM(OutstandingInvestmentProrated) AS OutstandingInvestment_Shared  
    FROM DW.CI_Treasury_Corporate_En  
    GROUP BY FCBSCIF  
)

SELECT TOP 10000
CustomerID
,CustomerName
,GlobalCIF
,EntityCIF
,FCBSCIF
,CustomerType
,DateOfIncorporation
,MaritalStatus
,Gender
,MobileNumber
,EmailAddress
,AddressLine1
,AddressLine2
,City
,Province
,ZipCode
,Country
,SMEClassification
,LineOfActivity
,IndustryDescription
,Subsector
,SubsectorDescription
,Tenure
,TotalRelationshipBalance_Full
,TotalRelationshipBalance_Shared
,TotalMTDADBPHPDeposits_Full
,TotalMTDADBPHPDeposits_Shared
,TotalYTDADBPHPDeposits_Full
,TotalYTDADBPHPDeposits_Shared
,TotalOutBalPHPDeposits_Full
,TotalOutBalPHPDeposits_Shared
,TotalRelationshipExposureLoans_Full
,TotalRelationshipExposureLoans_Shared
,TotalOutBalPHPLoans_Full
,TotalOutBalPHPLoans_Shared
,TotalCreditLimitLoans_Full
,TotalCreditLimitLoans_Shared
,TotalOutBalPHPCards
,TotalOutstandingBalanceCards
,TotalCreditLimitCards
,TotalRelationshipExposureLoansCards_Full
,TotalRelationshipExposureLoansCards_Shared
,TotalSecuritiesPortfolioSizeCBSEC_Full
,TotalSecuritiesPortfolioSizeCBSEC_Shared
,TotalFundValueTrust_Full
,TotalFundValueTrust_Shared
,TotalOutstandingInvestmentTRY_Full
,TotalOutstandingInvestmentTRY_Shared
,DataPrivacyConsent
,LastKYCDate
,RiskRatingType
,RiskRating
,SuspendedIndicator
,ATMEnrollmentIndicator
,MBKEnrollmentIndicator
,RIBBOBEnrollmentIndicator                                                                                                                                                      
,PayrollIndicator
,GenerationalCohort
,MarketSegment 
,LastUpdatedDate
,BusinessDate                                                                                                                               
INTO DW.CI_Demographics_Corporate_En
FROM (
SELECT 
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY DDC.CUSTOMERID ORDER BY DA.PayrollIndicator DESC) RN
,DDC.CustomerId AS CustomerID
,DDC.EntityCIF as CustomerName
--,DDC.CustomerName AS CustomerName
,DDC.GlobalCIF AS GlobalCIF
,DDC.EntityCIF AS EntityCIF
,DDC.FCBSCIF AS FCBSCIF
,DDC.CustomerType AS CustomerType
, '01-01-1900' as DateOfIncorporation
--,DDC.DateOfIncorporation AS DateOfIncorporation
,DDC.MaritalStatus AS MaritalStatus
,DDC.Gender AS Gender
,'****-***-****' AS MobileNumber
--,DDC.MobileNumber AS MobileNumber
,'********@mail.com' AS EmailAddress
--,DDC.Email AS EmailAddress
,'********' AS AddressLine1
--,DDC.AddressLine1 AS AddressLine1
,DDC.AddressLine2 AS AddressLine2
,DDC.City AS City
,DDC.Province AS Province
,DDC.ZipCode AS ZipCode
,DDC.Country AS Country
,DDC.SMEClassification AS SMEClassification
,DDC.LineOfActivity AS LineOfActivity
,DDC.IndustryDescription AS IndustryDescription
,DDC.Subsector AS Subsector
,DDC.SubsectorDescription AS SubsectorDescription
,(YEAR(getdate()) - Year(MIN(DA.AccountOpenedDate))) AS Tenure
,ISNULL(CDR.YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Full,0) + ISNULL(CTR.AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Full,0) + ISNULL(CTRR.OutstandingInvestment_Full,0) AS TotalRelationshipBalance_Full
,ISNULL(CDR.YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Shared,0) + ISNULL(CTR.AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Shared,0) + ISNULL(CTRR.OutstandingInvestment_Shared,0) AS TotalRelationshipBalance_Shared
,CDR.MonthToDateAverageDailyBalance_Full AS TotalMTDADBPHPDeposits_Full
,CDR.MonthToDateAverageDailyBalance_Shared AS TotalMTDADBPHPDeposits_Shared
,CDR.YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Full AS TotalYTDADBPHPDeposits_Full
,CDR.YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Shared AS TotalYTDADBPHPDeposits_Shared
,CDR.OutstandingBalance_Full AS TotalOutBalPHPDeposits_Full
,CDR.OutstandingBalance_Shared AS TotalOutBalPHPDeposits_Shared
,CLR.RelationshipExposure_Full AS TotalRelationshipExposureLoans_Full
,CLR.RelationshipExposure_Shared AS TotalRelationshipExposureLoans_Shared
,CLR.DueForTheMonth_Full AS TotalOutBalPHPLoans_Full
,CLR.DueForTheMonth_Shared AS TotalOutBalPHPLoans_Shared
,CLR.CreditLimit_Full AS TotalCreditLimitLoans_Full
,CLR.CreditLimit_Shared AS TotalCreditLimitLoans_Shared
,CCR.RelationshipExposure AS TotalOutBalPHPCards
,CCR.StatementBalance AS TotalOutstandingBalanceCards
,CCR.CreditLimit AS TotalCreditLimitCards
,CLR.RelationshipExposure_Full + CCR.RelationshipExposure AS TotalRelationshipExposureLoansCards_Full
,CLR.RelationshipExposure_Shared + CCR.RelationshipExposure AS TotalRelationshipExposureLoansCards_Shared
,CSR.PortfolioSize_Full AS TotalSecuritiesPortfolioSizeCBSEC_Full
,CSR.PortfolioSize_Shared AS TotalSecuritiesPortfolioSizeCBSEC_Shared
,CTR.AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Full AS TotalFundValueTrust_Full
,CTR.AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Shared AS TotalFundValueTrust_Shared
,CTRR.OutstandingInvestment_Full AS TotalOutstandingInvestmentTRY_Full
,CTRR.OutstandingInvestment_Shared AS TotalOutstandingInvestmentTRY_Shared
,DDC.DataPrivacyConsent AS DataPrivacyConsent
,DDC.LastKYCDate AS LastKYCDate
,DDRT.RiskRatingTypeName AS RiskRatingType
,DDR.RiskRatingName AS RiskRating
,DDC.SuspendedIndicator AS SuspendedIndicator
,DDC.ATMEnrollmentIndicator AS ATMEnrollmentIndicator
,DDC.MobileBankingEnrollmentIndicator AS MBKEnrollmentIndicator
,DDC.OnlineBankingEnrollmentIndicator AS RIBBOBEnrollmentIndicator                                                                                                                                                      
,CASE
    WHEN DA.PayrollIndicator = 'Y' THEN DA.PayrollIndicator 
    ELSE 'N' END AS PayrollIndicator
,DGC.GenerationalCohortName AS GenerationalCohort 
,  CASE WHEN DDM.MarketSegmentID IS NULL AND ISNULL(CDR.YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Shared,0) + ISNULL(CSR.PortfolioSize_Shared,0) + ISNULL(CTR.AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Shared,0) + ISNULL(CTRR.OutstandingInvestment_Shared,0) >=  10000000
             THEN 'VIP'
        WHEN DDM.MarketSegmentID IS NULL AND ISNULL(CDR.YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Shared,0) + ISNULL(CSR.PortfolioSize_Shared,0) + ISNULL(CTR.AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Shared,0) + ISNULL(CTRR.OutstandingInvestment_Shared,0) <  1  
             THEN 'MM'
        ELSE DDM.MarketSegmentName END AS MarketSegment
,DDC.ValidStartDate AS LastUpdatedDate
,FTR.BusinessDateSK AS BusinessDate                                                                         
FROM 
DimCustomer DDC
JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount DDCA ON DDC.CustomerSK = DDCA.CustomerSK 
JOIN DimAccount DA ON DDCA.AccountSK = DA.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN CI_Deposits_Corporate CDR ON CDR.FCBSCIF = DDC.FCBSCIF
LEFT JOIN CI_Cards_Corporate CCR ON CCR.FCBSCIF = DDC.FCBSCIF
LEFT JOIN CI_Loans_Corporate CLR ON CLR.FCBSCIF = DDC.FCBSCIF
LEFT JOIN CI_Securities_Corporate CSR ON CSR.FCBSCIF = DDC.FCBSCIF 
LEFT JOIN CI_Trust_Corporate CTR ON CTR.FCBSCIF = DDC.FCBSCIF 
LEFT JOIN CI_Treasury_Corporate CTRR ON CTRR.FCBSCIF = DDC.FCBSCIF 
Left JOIN DimCustomerRisk DDRR ON DDC.CustomerSK = DDRR.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT RiskRatingTypeSK, RiskRatingTypeName FROM DW.DimRiskRatingType) DDRT ON DDRR.RiskRatingTypeSK = DDRT.RiskRatingTypeSk 
LEFT JOIN (SELECT RiskRatingSK,RiskRatingName FROM Dw.DimRiskRating) DDR ON DDRR.RiskRatingSK = DDR.RiskRatingSK 
LEFT JOIN DW.DimGenerationalCohort DGC ON DGC.GenerationalCohortSK = DDC.GenerationalCohortSK
LEFT JOIN DW.FactTotalRelationshipBalance FTR ON DDC.CustomerSK = FTR.CustomerSK 
LEFT JOIN (SELECT MarketSegmentSK, LowerLimit, UpperLimit,MarketSegmentName,MarketSegmentID FROM DW.DimMarketSegment) DDM 
ON ISNULL(CDR.OutstandingBalance_Shared,0) + ISNULL(CSR.PortfolioSize_Shared,0) + ISNULL(CTR.AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Shared,0) + ISNULL(CTRR.OutstandingInvestment_Shared,0) < DDM.UpperLimit 
AND  ISNULL(CDR.OutstandingBalance_Shared,0) + ISNULL(CSR.PortfolioSize_Shared,0) + ISNULL(CTR.AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Shared,0) + ISNULL(CTRR.OutstandingInvestment_Shared,0) >= DDM.LowerLimit
WHERE CASE WHEN DDM.MarketSegmentID IS NULL AND ISNULL(CDR.YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Shared,0) + ISNULL(CSR.PortfolioSize_Shared,0) + ISNULL(CTR.AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Shared,0) + ISNULL(CTRR.OutstandingInvestment_Shared,0) >=  10000000
                THEN 'VIP'
           WHEN DDM.MarketSegmentID IS NULL AND ISNULL(CDR.YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Shared,0) + ISNULL(CSR.PortfolioSize_Shared,0) + ISNULL(CTR.AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Shared,0) + ISNULL(CTRR.OutstandingInvestment_Shared,0) <  1  
                THEN 'MM1'  
ELSE DDM.MarketSegmentID END IN ('MA', 'UA', 'VIP') AND CDR.YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Shared > 20000 

GROUP BY 
DDC.CustomerId
,DDC.CustomerName
,DDC.GlobalCIF
,DDC.EntityCIF
,DDC.FCBSCIF
,DDC.CustomerType
,DDC.DateOfIncorporation
,DDC.MaritalStatus
,DDC.Gender
,DDC.MobileNumber
,DDC.Email
,DDC.AddressLine1
,DDC.AddressLine2
,DDC.City
,DDC.Province
,DDC.ZipCode
,DDC.Country
,DDC.SMEClassification
,DDC.LineOfActivity
,DDC.IndustryDescription
,DDC.Subsector
,DDC.SubsectorDescription
,CDR.MonthToDateAverageDailyBalance_Full
,CDR.MonthToDateAverageDailyBalance_Shared
,CDR.YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Full
,CDR.YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Shared
,CDR.OutstandingBalance_Full
,CDR.OutstandingBalance_Shared
,CLR.RelationshipExposure_Full
,CLR.RelationshipExposure_Shared
,CLR.DueForTheMonth_Full
,CLR.DueForTheMonth_Shared
,CLR.CreditLimit_Full
,CLR.CreditLimit_Shared
,CCR.RelationshipExposure
,CCR.StatementBalance 
,CCR.CreditLimit 
,CSR.PortfolioSize_Full
,CSR.PortfolioSize_Shared
,CTR.AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Full
,CTR.AssetsUnderManagementBalance_Shared
,CTRR.OutstandingInvestment_Full
,CTRR.OutstandingInvestment_Shared
,DDC.DataPrivacyConsent
,DDC.LastKYCDate
,DDRT.RiskRatingTypeName
,DDR.RiskRatingName
,DDC.SuspendedIndicator
,DDC.ATMEnrollmentIndicator
,DDC.MobileBankingEnrollmentIndicator
,DDC.OnlineBankingEnrollmentIndicator
,DA.PayrollIndicator
,DGC.GenerationalCohortName
,DDM.MarketSegmentName
,DDC.ValidStartDate 
,FTR.BusinessDateSK
,DDM.MarketSegmentID 
) A WHERE RN =1
END
GO
